summary: Phase 1 (onboarding + physique profile) tested end to end. Backend: new suite test_physique_onboarding.py has 19/19 passing (PATCH /me validation, fresh-user defaults, existing-user onboarding_completed=true, bulk measurements valid/invalid, body-weight CRUD, per-user isolation, 25-350 kg range, future dates rejected, export/reset). Regression suites: 39/39 passing with -n 0 (preview email and cron run tests skipped), after updating two stale assertions that used 'Neck' as an invalid body part. UI: two fresh Clerk users went through onboarding on mobile and desktop. Checked: imperial with measurements, metric with weight skipped and 'Add later'; redirect to /welcome; height validation; CM/FT-IN conversions (175.3 -> 5 ft 9 in -> 175.3; 5 ft 9 in -> 175.3); review, save, 'You're set up' and Continue to Home; /welcome redirects to Home afterwards. Persisted values were correct (inches stored as cm*2.54, 154 lb -> 69.85 kg). Also checked Profile Physique (height save/reload/unit kept, weight log/delete, lb display when imperial), Measurements Full set and single-mode default sides, and Alex's data (matches the pre-phase backup: 3 workouts, 2 measurements, 1 photo, 1 goal, 1 plan; not forced into onboarding). One functional bug found: inches 12 or more are not blocked.

minor.issue: Side is not checked against the body part: Neck/Left, Arms/Midline and a Neck/Right goal are all accepted. Bulk also accepts the same part+side twice in one request

ui_bugs.issue: Entering inches >= 12 (e.g. 5 ft 12 in) shows the 'Inches must be between 0 and 11.9' error, but onboarding Next still moves on and Profile 'Save height' still saves it as 6 ft 0 in (182.9 cm). OnboardingPage.next() and HeightCard.save() only check heightError(cm), not the inchBad state inside HeightInput. Negative inches or feet would also pass if the total stays in 100-250 cm

issues: Bilateral labels are plural: 'Left forearms', 'Right thighs', 'Left calves'. They should be singular ('Left forearm', 'Right thigh'), in line with 'Left upper arm'

design_issues.screen: Home 'Latest measurements' and Progress (goal card title, part chips)
issues: These still show 'Arms' instead of the new 'Upper arm' label (partLabel is not used). Measurements empty-state text also says 'No measurements for Arms'
Choosing a midline part (Neck, Waist, Hips, Glutes...) keeps the side as Right, so the chart is empty until the user taps Midline. Use defaultSide() here too

On first view the Model 5 image had naturalWidth 0 and showed as a black box during the rise animation (the 57 KB webp had not loaded yet). It loaded in Profile. Consider preloading it on earlier steps

action_items: Block inches >= 12 (and negative ft/in) in OnboardingPage.next() and HeightCard.save(). For example, export a validator from HeightInput that takes the ft/in fields, or have HeightInput call onChange(NaN) or report the error to its parent
Use singular labels for bilateral parts in MeasurementSetForm
Use partLabel() on Home latest measurements and on Progress chips/goal titles; use defaultSide() when a part is picked on Progress
Optional: check that side matches the part in the backend (midline parts -> Midline; bilateral parts -> Left/Right/Both)
critical_code_review_comments: HeightInput keeps inchBad as internal state that the parent cannot see. This is the root cause of the inches bug

Onboarding save() runs three requests in a row (body-weights, bulk, PATCH /me). If PATCH fails after the first two succeed, a retry posts the weight and measurements again (duplicates). Do PATCH first, or skip the steps that already succeeded on retry

public_me defaults onboarding_completed to True when the field is missing. A user doc created by any other path without the field (not via current_member setOnInsert) also skips onboarding. This is the intended behaviour for legacy users
Body-weight date input keeps the last date after logging, so quick repeat logs reuse the old date (minor UX)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; inches validation bug)

test_credentials: Used athlete (Alex) and athlete2 (Ben) from test_credentials.md, plus newly created onbui14ceb9+clerk_test and onbui39e1e3+clerk_test (recorded in test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Fresh Clerk users created (see above), plus onbtest* users created by the pytest run. Ben is reset by the goals suite. Alex is unchanged (UI only read data; timezone sync may have PATCHed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use python3 /app/tests/clerk_fresh_ticket.py for a new user and ticket for onboarding. Run pytest with -n 0 and -k 'not preview_email_and_rate_limit and not cron_run_id' to avoid sending emails. Container date is Oct 2026. Retest: inches >= 12 must be blocked in onboarding and Profile.
